ConsentRecord.title: ConsentRecord
ConsentRecord.description: Explicit patient consent record required prior to AI image processing and encrypted cloud storage.

patientUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the consenting patient.

policyVersion.description: Version identifier of the Care Aid Ai Data Handling Policy.

consentGranted.description: True if explicit consent is active.

allowProcessing.description: True if user explicitly consents to multimodal first-aid image analysis.

forbidAiTraining.description: True confirming patient images must never be used for AI model training.

acknowledgesNoDiagnosis.description: True confirming understanding that image analysis is not a medical diagnosis.

signatureHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the signed consent statement.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when consent was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when consent was last updated.

EncryptedPatientImage.title: EncryptedPatientImage
EncryptedPatientImage.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted patient image record stored in Firestore with strict RBAC and consent linkage.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the patient who owns this image.

consentId.description: Document ID of the active ConsentRecord authorizing this image.

caseTitle.description: Label of the clinical case or body area.

viewLabel.description: Camera angle label (Front view, Side view, Close-up, Comparison with an earlier image).

dayLabel.description: Timeline progression day marker (e.g. Day 1, Day 3, Day 7).

ciphertextBase64.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted image payload encoded as Base64.

sha256Digest.description: SHA-256 integrity hash of the encrypted payload.

privacyMasked.description: True if peripheral identifying features were masked before encryption.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the encrypted record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when encrypted image was stored.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record metadata was last updated.

AuthorizedPersonnel.title: AuthorizedPersonnel
AuthorizedPersonnel.description: Registry of authorized healthcare/security personnel permitted to audit or review escalated records.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authorized clinician or security officer.

displayName.description: Full name and credentials of the authorized personnel.

badgeId.description: Clinical license or personnel badge identifier.

createdByUid.description: UID of the administrator who authorized this personnel record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when authorization was granted.

SecurityAuditLog.title: SecurityAuditLog
SecurityAuditLog.description: Immutable security audit entry recording consent, encryption, access, and permanent deletion events.

actorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who triggered the event.

targetResourceId.description: ID of the consent or encrypted image record affected.

details.description: Non-PII cryptographic summary of the security operation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the security event.

/consents/{consentId}.description: Stores explicit patient consent records keyed by user UID or consent ID.

/encrypted_images/{imageId}.description: Stores AES-256-GCM encrypted patient images linked to an active ConsentRecord.

/authorized_personnel/{personnelId}.description: Stores authorized personnel records managed strictly by administrators.
